name: only-monsters-remain
description: A curated Witcher 3 modlist and game guide — Only Monsters Remain

scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const src='.vitepress/dist'; const dest='output/site'; const path=require('path'); const srcPath=path.resolve(src); if(!fs.existsSync(srcPath)){console.log('Src '+srcPath+' not found, skipping');process.exit(0)} if(fs.existsSync(dest)) fs.rmSync(dest,{recursive:true}); fs.cpSync(srcPath,dest,{recursive:true}); console.log('Moved site to '+dest);"
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run pdf
